title: How GLM built its own inference infrastructure
why_read: A detailed engineering account of building inference infrastructure for a large open-weight LLM is genuinely useful for anyone working on serving models at scale.
analysis: GLM is a large language model family, and this post describes the systems engineering behind serving it efficiently at scale, likely covering topics like batching, KV-cache management, and hardware utilization. Inference infrastructure is one of the harder practical problems in deploying LLMs, and first-hand accounts from teams who built such systems are relatively rare and valuable. The high comment count suggests substantive technical discussion among practitioners.
